result.reason: The operative language substantially reaches the preferred position: it adds the required mutual cap, all specified uncapped carve-outs, and preserves the mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages. It is slightly broader than necessary because it treats amounts owed by either Party under Section 5 as outside the cap, whereas the playbook specifies only Customer payment obligations. Drafting is generally professional, though “Excluded Claims” is defined partly by reference to obligations and conduct rather than claims or liabilities, and the original typographical error remains.
